selection.rule: Among PCA weights with mean validation RMSE no more than tolerance above the best PCA mean validation RMSE, select the one with the lowest mean validation PDE residual; ties prefer lower validation RMSE, then lower lambda.

protocol.nested_split: One fixed outer test set is excluded from all seed-specific training and validation sets. Validation times are sampled only from the remaining development times.
protocol.selection_rule: Among PCA weights with mean validation RMSE no more than tolerance above the best PCA mean validation RMSE, select the one with the lowest mean validation PDE residual; ties prefer lower validation RMSE, then lower lambda.
protocol.selection_cutoff: 15% tolerance over the best mean validation RMSE among PCA weights; select lowest mean validation PDE residual among feasible weights.
protocol.test_timing: PCA weight is chosen from aggregated validation metrics before any test residual/solution metric is computed. Test is evaluated only for the selected lambda and the base comparator.
protocol.pca_scope: PCA is fitted only on supervised training-time snapshots; validation and outer test targets are excluded.
protocol.same_residual_operator: JAX autodifferentiation is used for the training PDE residual in baseline and PCA.
protocol.pde_metric: Validation and final test PDE residual are scored with the same finite-difference operator on the complete prediction grid.
protocol.timing: JAX compilation is measured separately; PCA pipeline time includes its training-only basis fit.
